sloka: यः तु एनम् विषम आचारः पाप कर्मा अधिरोहति ।तत्र एव प्रहरन्ति एनम् सुप्तम् आदाय राक्षसाः ॥३-७३-३४॥
transliteration: yaḥ tu enam viṣama ācāraḥ pāpa karmā adhirohati ।tatra eva praharanti enam suptam ādāya rākṣasāḥ ॥3-73-34॥

translations.english: If an evildoer or a sinner ascends the (Rishyamuka) mountain, he, in his sleep, will be thrown down with asleep by the demons from there itself. A sinner does not climb this mountain of uneven terrain.
